About Everforth Quinnox :




Everforth Quinnox is an AI-first Digital Always organization orchestrating value for forward-looking businesses. Through AI-powered platforms and intelligent engineering teams, we accelerate digital transformation, redefine total experience, and improve productivity and operational efficiency.

Our AI-first workforce turns challenges and opportunities into a competitive edge, fueling growth, sparking innovation, and building resilience for accelerated time to value.

At the core of Everforth Quinnoxs innovation is the Services as Software (SaS) model, transforming traditional IT services into an intelligent, self-evolving ecosystem. Powered by Agentic AI, this ecosystem autonomously designs, tests, orchestrates, and manages operations, continuously learning and improving to deliver scalable, resilient, and outcome-driven business value.

Everforth Quinnox is headquartered in the United States, with a strong global delivery presence across the US, UK, and India. Our work is consistently recognized by leading industry analysts for its real, tangible impact and is strengthened by a robust partner ecosystem.




JD :




Gen AI Engineer Azure Stack: Key Talking Points

Core Mandate: Build and run production-grade agentic AI systems on Azure multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and secure enterprise integrations, end-to-end from prototyping through governance and cost optimization.
Technical Depth Required: 5+ years in software/ML engineering, with 2+ years specifically on LLM/agent systems. Strong Python, hands-on with agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), and proven MCP server deployment experience this is a builder, not a prompt-engineer role.
Azure-Native Stack: Deep fluency across Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AKS, Functions, Event Grid/Service Bus, and Key Vault plus RAG proficiency (Azure Cognitive Search/vector DBs, embeddings, retrieval tuning).
Enterprise-Grade Rigor: Strong emphasis on LLMOps (CI/CD for agents, evaluation pipelines, prompt versioning), security/compliance (Entra ID, secrets management, content safety, audit logging), and observability/FinOps (token cost, latency, throughput optimization) signals this is for serious production deployments, not POCs.
